description: List bookings: one entry per one-off booking and one per recurring series (first instance only). Filter by member, company, location, resource, series start window and status. For every individual occurrence in a date window use officernd_list_booking_occurrences. OfficeRnD: GET /bookings.

cursor_next.description: The cursorNext from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

cursor_prev.description: The cursorPrev from a page, to go one page back.

modified_since.description: Only items modified at or after this time (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z).

starts_before.description: Only bookings/series starting before this time (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z).

starts_from.description: Only bookings/series starting at or after this time (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z).

name: officernd_list_bookings
title: List bookings
